name: What is the process for preparing my walls for box molding?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for preparing my walls for box molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your walls is an important step to ensure the best outcome for your box molding installation. This involves cleaning the wall surfaces to remove dust and debris, filling any significant holes or cracks with spackle or joint compound, and then sanding these areas smooth. A uniform, clean surface allows for better adhesion of the molding and a more professional final look. Additionally, deciding on the exact placement and layout of your box molding before installation helps streamline the process and ensures design accuracy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wall preparation for box molding involves cleaning, filling holes, and sanding smooth. A clean, uniform surface ensures proper adhesion and a professional finish.
